usedFor: Shopify is where orders arrive and QuickBooks is where they become invoices. “New Order” in Shopify can run “Create Invoice”, so every sale reaches accounting without re-keying.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in Shopify, then “Create Invoice” in QuickBooks
bestTemplate.why: “New Order” is pushed as the sale happens and “Create Invoice” is the one Shopify template that produces a bookkeeping record from an order.

watchOut: “Create Payment” records a payment, but the Shopify triggers that reach it are “New Customer”, “Order Cancelled” and edited line items. None of those is a payment, so check what you map.
